artworks.title: Green River, Wyoming Territory
artworks.medium: etching in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water in the foreground and towering rock formations in the distance. The scene is depicted with intricate lines resembling an etching or engraving, creating texture and depth. The color palette consists of sepia tones. The water reflects the sky and distant landforms, with reeds and grasses at the shore. Trees line the banks, framing the cliffs. Wispy clouds fill the sky above.

artworks.title: The Much Resounding Sea
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and roulette in black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with a shoreline view of a stormy sea. The horizon is in the upper third, where the sky meets the waves. People on the beach appear to be dealing with an urgent situation, with one holding a rope. Debris is scattered on the sandy shore. A lifeboat with people is seen in the distance, navigating the rough waters. In the background, a tilted ship is faintly visible against the sky. Detailed lines depict the water and sky motion. The color scheme is monochromatic in different shades of gray, emphasizing the intense atmosphere.

artworks.title: Bridge in the Pass of Glencoe—Scotland
artworks.medium: etching and roulette in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image presents a landscape scene viewed from a vantage point that allows for a sweeping view over rocky, uneven terrain. Close to us, rough brushstrokes depict detailed rocks and sparse vegetation, leading the eye through a winding path toward a stone bridge that arches over a narrow gorge. The bridge is positioned as a focal point atop the hill, dividing the scene between the land closest to us and the mountainous landscape beyond. In the distance, rugged hills covered in deeply etched lines slope upward, meeting a sky filled with dramatic, radiating strokes. The horizon is indistinct, seamlessly blending the sky with the peaks of the hills. The overall color palette is monochromatic, relying on varying shades between black and white to craft a scene rich in texture and depth.

artworks.title: Morning
artworks.medium: etching, sandpaper ground, and roulette in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a dirt path bordered by wooden fences, leading towards a horizon where land meets water. Small boats can be seen in the distance. The detailed etching technique creates texture and depth in the scene, from the rugged terrain to the sky. The color palette is sepia, giving an antique quality to the scenery. Clouds fill the sky, adding to the serene atmosphere and showcasing the artist's handling of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Moonlight at Low Tide
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 12.7 x 19.6 cm (5 x 7 11/16 in.)
sheet: 22.8 x 33 cm (9 x 13 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a nautical scene with a body of water under a night sky. The horizon is low in the composition. A sailboat is silhouetted against the water, lit by a full moon partially hidden by clouds. The sky and water are detailed with varied texture, with dark outlines contrasting against the moonlit path on the water. The color palette is monochromatic with black, gray, and the moon's pale glow.

artworks.title: The Early Ploughman
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a low vantage point. It shows a rural scene with a horizon near the upper third of the composition. In the distance, there are silhouetted mountains and a structure on a hill. The artwork features dense cross-hatching brushwork creating a textured look in the sky and landscape. The color palette is monochromatic with browns and dark sepia tones. A farmer is seen plowing a field with oxen, and a figure is standing near tall trees. Birds fly in the sky above.

artworks.title: The Weary Ploughman
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé
artworks.description: The artwork shows a low vantage point scene with an overcast landscape. Dense, textured trees are on the left side, and the horizon line is low with mountains in the background. The sky is meticulously painted with fine brushstrokes, focusing on light gradations. The color palette is monochromatic in black and white, creating a dramatic ambiance. There is a figure with a stick, two large animals, and a smaller animal on the left side. In the distance, a faintly sketched structure adds depth.

artworks.title: The Rising Moon
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene viewed from a low perspective. The horizon is high in the composition, with distant trees and a hill with the sun. The artwork features detailed line work using hatching and cross-hatching for texture and depth. Sheep are resting, a human is standing nearby with farming tools, and structures and trees are in the middle ground. The color palette is monochromatic with black, off-white, and sepia tones, creating a dusk or dawn atmosphere.

artworks.title: Rainy Night, Charing Cross Shops
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a bird's-eye view of a street scene on a rainy day. The composition focuses on the street with buildings lining the left side. People are scattered across the wet street, all carrying umbrellas, moving through the rain. A horse-drawn carriage is traveling along a road bordered by a fence. Thick and impressionistic brushstrokes create a sense of motion and rain through diagonal lines. The color palette is monochromatic, utilizing varying shades of black and brown, with the wet street reflecting light.

artworks.title: Winter Quarters - Cape Ann
artworks.medium: etching in black on imitation Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene from an elevated viewpoint, providing a broad perspective of the waterfront. The horizon is positioned high, with ships, buildings, and the sky meeting. Fine lines define the ships and buildings, with swirling lines suggesting movement or weather. The water's surface is depicted with less detail. In the distance, more ships and industrial buildings line the dock. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of sepia and thin lines conveying a historical quality.

artworks.title: Orchard
artworks.medium: etching in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a man leaning on a stick under a tree. The horizon is in the upper half and the terrain is sloping. Trees and clouds are detailed with fine lines. The color scheme is black and white. Branches, trunks, and sparse foliage are visible, with the man in dark clothing looking down.

artworks.title: A Bit on Marblehead Neck
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with a low horizon line, emphasizing the sky. In the background, there are cliffs meeting the ocean with small waves. In the foreground, sheep are grazing on rocky terrain. The artwork is created using fine lines to depict textures, with a monochromatic palette of brown shades creating contrast between landforms, animals, and the sky.

artworks.title: A Fallow Field
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is positioned high, allowing for an expansive view of the rolling fields and clusters of trees. A line of trees is in the distance, creating a natural boundary for the scene. The artist employs fine and delicate etching lines that convey texture and detail in the foliage and landscape features. A group of sheep are depicted grazing on the slope close to us. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing contrast and detail rather than color variation, highlighting the intricacy of the etched lines.

artworks.title: An Old Dam Near Montrose
artworks.medium: aquatint in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a high horizon featuring rolling hills, trees, and a shallow river or stream in the foreground. The water reflects surrounding foliage with gentle ripples and varied light patches. The brushstrokes are varied and delicate, capturing the surface textures and dense vegetation. The color palette is muted with sepia tones. Natural elements like grasses and trees are loosely sketched, creating a tranquil atmosphere under a softly rendered sky with diffused clouds.

artworks.title: An Old Dam Near Montrose
artworks.medium: aquatint in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a calm body of water, distant hills, a line of trees, and a small bridge. The perspective is low to the ground, with a monochromatic color palette of varying shades of gray and sepia. The brushstrokes are delicate and soft. Vegetation lines the water's edge, and the water surface reflects the sky above.

artworks.title: Emma Rasmussen
artworks.medium: etching on Van der Ley laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman in a full upper body portrait. She is leaning forward with one hand under her chin. Her features include delicate eyes, a small nose, slightly parted lips, and curly hair falling around her shoulders. She wears a dress with ruffled sleeves. The background features abstract patterns and crosshatching. The artwork style appears to be etched or engraved with fine lines defining form and texture.

artworks.title: The Two
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This print depicts two nude people, a man and a woman, shown from head to toe. Both people are standing upright on an uneven, rocky landscape, looking out over the scene with their bodies facing slightly towards the left. The woman is in front, and she has light skin and short, dark hair. The man stands behind her with a hand on her arm. He also has light skin and dark hair neatly combed back, along with a dark mustache. Their bodies have been created with short, fine lines, and there is not much detail in their facial features. The background features a natural landscape with rocky, sloped terrain and patches of dark grass under a clear sky. The dark lines of the print are on tan paper.

artworks.title: Michel Lepelletier
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner (printed in blue, red, yellow, and black inks)
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to platemark): 35.3 x 28 cm (13 7/8 x 11 in.)
overall (framing line): 24.6 x 21.8 cm (9 11/16 x 8 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up, positioned slightly at an angle, looking to his left. He has mature facial features with a prominent nose and lips. His hair is gray and styled in a voluminous manner, extending back from his forehead. He is wearing a dark-colored coat with a high collar, and underneath, a pink waistcoat is visible. Around his neck, he has a large, intricately tied white cravat. There is no jewelry visible or objects in his hands. The portrait is set against an oval, mottled dark brown background, framed with his name, Michel Lepelletier, inscribed below.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome Penitent
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 10.7 x 8.5 cm (4 3/16 x 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated figure against a rocky surface. The person has an aged appearance with prominent facial features, a long beard, and curly hair that thins towards the top of the head. The figure's shoulders and arms are bare, while a draped fabric covers the waist and lower body. In one hand, the person holds a large crucifix or cross-like object. In the scene with the figure is an open book and a human skull, lying near each other at the bottom right corner. The background consists of rough and textured rock formations, suggesting a cave-like setting.

artworks.title: Mucius Scaevola
artworks.medium: sepia ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene indoors with dynamic figures. The drawing depicts an interior setting with elaborate drapery hanging from the ceiling. The figures are engaged in discussion or confrontation, gesturing animatedly. A central table is present in the scene, cluttered with various objects. On the floor, there are two figures lying down. The use of shading and intricate linework adds depth to the piece.

artworks.title: Horses
artworks.artist: French 19th Century (Possibly Alexandre-Gabriel Decamps) after Paulus Potter
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white on brown paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two horses standing together. The drawing depicts two horses rendered in charcoal or pencil on a piece of paper. One horse faces the viewer with its head turned slightly, while the other faces away, showing only its hindquarters. The texture and shadowing capture the physique of the animals, emphasizing their rounded forms and muscular bodies with swift strokes. In the sky behind them is a suggestion of clouds sketched with similar lines. The paper has visible wear and a few tears on the edges.

artworks.title: Rider in the Countryside
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white on brown paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a low horizon view of an open landscape. The sketch features loose brushstrokes with visible pencil or charcoal lines outlining trees, figures, and animals. The color palette is muted, with earthy browns and greys dominating. In the foreground, there are vegetation and undefined shapes. Further back, a figure rides a horse, accompanied by two other animals. The background shows sketched silhouettes of trees.

artworks.title: Pêcheur en Canot, au bord d'une Rivière (Fisherman in a Boat)
artworks.medium: etching with monoprint inking on China paper
artworks.description: The image shows a calm, narrow river bordered by dense trees. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, looking down at the scene. Tall trees and grazing animals are silhouetted against the sky. The style appears to be fine etching, with delicate lines creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly shades of gray and black. In the foreground, a figure sits in a rowboat, framed by reeds. On the opposite bank, there are figures and animals in the misty distance.

artworks.title: Carew Castle, Pembrokeshire
artworks.medium: watercolor
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a castle in the distance. The viewpoint is slightly upward, with the castle silhouetted against the sky. The painting uses fluid brushwork and sepia tones, creating a warm and nostalgic atmosphere. Trees with dense foliage frame the left side, the ground is subtly undulating, and hills are visible in the background. Wispy clouds are dispersed in the sky, adding depth to the scene.
